# Before the Stars — 中文术语表 (zh-Hans; zh-Hant is generated by OpenCC + overrides)

Tone: clear, concise modern Chinese for a serious strategy game. Whole-sentence keys, Chinese
punctuation (，。：；、“”), no space between a number and its measure word unless the number is an
element (bold). Region names (generated syllables) stay in Latin letters.

## Core loop
| English | 中文 | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| round / year / month | 回合 / 年 / 月 | Year 25 → 第25年；Year 4, month 7 → 第4年7月；month 245 (evidence) → 第245月 |
| phase: contact selection / negotiation / planning | 阶段：选择交往对象 / 谈判 / 规划 | |
| window (negotiation) | 谈判窗口 | |
| briefing | 简报 | |
| chronicle / moment | 编年史 / 纪事 | |
| receipt | 回执 | accepted 已接受 · rejected 已驳回 · applied 已执行 |
| blocker | 阻碍 | |
| requirement | 条件 | "known requirement" 已知条件 |
| project | 项目 | |
| order (noun) | 指令 | |
| objective / agenda / milestone | 目标 / 议程 / 里程碑 | |
| steward / delegate | 执事 / 委托 | AI helper that runs a domain for the player |
| seat | 席位 | |
| referee (rules server) | 裁判端 | |

## Civilizations (worldgen CIV_ROOTS) — name / adjective share one Chinese form
Riverland(er) 河原 · Clearbay 澄湾 · Greenreach 青陲 · Farcape(r) 远岬 · Highmere 岚湖 · Stonewold(er) 磐丘 ·

## Numbers
Thousands separators stay (1,240). Large values use 万 / 亿 in compact form (1.24万, 310万, 1.2亿).
Ranges: "≈ 1,200–1,800" → "约 1,200–1,800". Lists join with "、". Percent stays "72%".

## Words with two meanings (same English key, different Chinese)
The engine keys on the English string, so a word that needs two renderings gets a context key
that only Chinese looks up (English keeps the plain word):
| English | Context key | 中文 |
|---|---|---|
| Civic (facility category) | `Civic` | 公共 |
| Civic (lineage trait) | `Civic (trait)` via `tcAs(name, 'trait')` | 乐群 |
| Active (seat status) | `Active` | 在局 |
| Active (treaty) | `Active (treaty status)` | 生效中 |
| Open (button) | `Open` | 打开 |
| Open (offer) | `Open (offer status)` | 待答复 |
| Settlement (inspector row, moment category) | `Settlement` | 聚落 |
| Settlement (project kind) | `Settlement (project)` | 拓殖 |
| People (population) | `People` | 人口 |
| People (table column) | `People (count)` | 人数 |
| Materials (good) | `Materials` | 建材 |
| Materials (course row) | `Materials (course)` | 耗材 |
| Withdraw (an offer) | `Withdraw` | 撤回 |
| Withdraw (forfeit) | `Withdraw (forfeit the match)` | 退出对局 |

## Traditional Chinese (zh-Hant)
Generated by `scripts/make-zh-hant.mjs` (OpenCC, Taiwan phrasing). Its phrase table pins ordinary
words that OpenCC would turn into computing jargon and applies Taiwan terms:
交往对象 stays 交往對象 (not 物件) · 循环 循環 (not 迴圈) · 通过 通過 (not 透過) · 谈判窗口 談判窗口 (not 視窗) ·
类型 類型 · 程序 (procedure) 程序 · 设备 設備 · 支持 支持 · 权限 權限 · 调度 調度 · 参数 參數;
计算机 電腦 · 程序员 程式設計師 · 激光 雷射 · 等离子体 電漿 · 裂变/聚变 核分裂/核融合 · 电站 電廠 · 变电站 變電所 ·
质量 品質 · 航天 航太 · 空间站 太空站 · 记录载体 記錄媒介 · 备件 備品 · 器件 元件 · 计划 計畫 · 项目 專案 (OpenCC).
Curly quotes become 「」. Characters OpenCC cannot disambiguate (谷→穀 in 穀穗/穀誓, 历→曆, 台→臺) are
corrected in `src/i18n/zh-Hant/overrides.json`.
